captain_candidates.evidence: Captain hit rate at the switch point: 0.4255 under the policy vs 0.4207 for raw EPA; paired 95% CI [-0.0126, 0.0198] includes 0, so no improvement over raw EPA is claimed (P5-M4 (c)).

ordering.evidence: M5 v2 after the event switch point, measured once (P5-M4 (b), .agent/phase5/results/p5_m4_event_analysis.json): mean Spearman 0.6138 vs raw EPA 0.5955 at the same snapshot; paired difference +0.0183, event-bootstrap 95% CI [0.0082, 0.0288], 208 events.

strongest_teams.evidence: M5 v2 after the event switch point, measured once (P5-M4 (b), .agent/phase5/results/p5_m4_event_analysis.json): mean Spearman 0.6138 vs raw EPA 0.5955 at the same snapshot; paired difference +0.0183, event-bootstrap 95% CI [0.0082, 0.0288], 208 events. Ordering only: no playoff or alliance-success probability is served (unvalidated; Phase 6).
